lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr28Fe8Si4 (reduced formula Zr7Fe2Si) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 216), with 40 atoms in the unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies two main environments for Fe: one with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Fe, 6 Zr) and one with 14 neighbors (8 Fe, 6 Zr), while Si adopts a close-packed-like arrangement with 12 Zr neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face contacts among Fe and Zr coordination polyhedra.
